metrics: Existing population_metrics with curvature_layers=false: H, hit@1/2/4, hit_infinity, utility, distinct events, legal rate, best reference rate.

comparisons: All original 24 arm pairs under both rankers, plus within-arm raw-minus-original H and difference-in-differences for all 24 comparisons.
gates: Input file hashes equal published scientific result hashes; original H reproduces published parent metrics within1e-12; all populations complete; rank-invariant metrics identical.
interpretation: Posthoc exploratory diagnostic after seeing smc-1. Not an independent confirmation, not new generation evidence, not replacement of smc-1. Report every comparison, no checkpoint selection.
resources: CPU only CUDA hidden, nice10, one worker, no GPU/no new xTB; stop if >1 CPU core-hour; do not modify input files.
